message.content:
A medium tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
If you’re looking at a 100‑gram serving, it’s about **18 calories**.  

These values can vary slightly depending on the tomato variety and ripeness, but 20–25 calories per medium tomato is a good rule of thumb.
